title: Anthropic Cash: $132B
headline: Who's sitting on $132B?
note: * Cash and liquid investments, before deducting debt.
caption:
Who's got $132B lying around? Anthropic.
Only Alphabet ($242B) has more. Amazon's at $123B, Meta $90B.
One page ↓
notes: Rebuild of a Futu NiuNiu card (Anthropic holds $132B cash, second only to Alphabet) into OPM format. Only the MIDDLE CONTENT AREA of the reference is used as layout reference: column headers, seven horizontal rows with a circular company logo + company name over ticker + proportional bar with an end tick + right-aligned amount, and one fully highlighted row (Anthropic). Title, top-right wordmark and footer follow OPM rules; white background, no dark theme, no watermark, no QR / Futu branding. Amounts converted from 億美元 to $B: $2420億=$242B, $1320億=$132B, $1230億=$123B, $900億=$90B, $770億=$77B, $750億=$75B, $700億=$70B. Bar lengths are proportional to the largest value (242). Source image cites company filings (10-Q / earnings), Anthropic S-1, FUNDA analysis, as of 2026-06-30; figures are reproduced from the supplied reference, not independently re-verified. All seven circular logos are cropped from the reference image by scripts/prepare_cash_logos.py (white circle, transparent outside). Caption follows the 2026-11-14 voice rule: question first, short, human, no preaching; old cards are not rewritten.
